title: Rab C. Nesbitt
creator: Ian Pattison
description: Writer Ian Pattison’s BBC Scotland sitcom about Rab C. Nesbitt, an unemployed street philosopher in a string vest, played by Gregor Fisher, and his family in Govan, the old shipbuilding district on the south bank of the Clyde.

title: The Angels’ Share
creator: Ken Loach
description: Director Ken Loach and writer Paul Laverty’s comedy about Robbie, a young Glaswegian sentenced in the city’s sheriff court to community service, who finds a nose for whisky. The Sheriff Court stands on the south bank of the Clyde in the Gorbals.
